notes.title: Update v0.1.4 – Improved AI and Performance!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][b]Soldiers,[/b][/p][p]Update [b]0.1.4[/b] for the [i]Beyond Enemy Lines – Vietnam[/i] demo is here, bringing major improvements to performance, AI, and gameplay features.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uI0m00E_Geo;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Improved Performance[/b] – Optimizations across the board for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overhauled AI Behaviour & Reaction Time[/b] – Enemies respond faster and act more intelligently in combat situations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated to Unreal Engine 5.6.0[/b] – Taking advantage of the latest engine improvements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Profile Section to Main Menu[/b] – Track your progress and stats more easily.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Weapon Skins[/b] – Customize your arsenal with new looks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added .50cal MG Nests to Operation Game Warden[/b] – New defensive positions to spice up engagements.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]AI Overhaul[/b][/h3][p]We have [b]drastically updated the AI behaviour[/b]. Enemies are now more aggressive, push forward, reposition more often, and actively try to evade you. We would like to hear your feedback on whether the new AI feels closer to what you expect.
Keep in mind: [b]this is still a work in progress[/b] – further improvements will follow as we fine-tune their tactics.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Weapon Skins[/b][/h3][p]Weapon skins have been added as an [b]additional reward[/b].
In the beta, [b]all skins are unlocked[/b] for testing purposes – in the final game, they will be earned through player ranks or mission-related rewards.[/p][p]We know skins can be a controversial topic, so here’s our approach:[/p][list][*][p][b]Realistic & Grounded:[/b] No flashy, unrealistic skins – only 2D paint with no extra 3D elements or moving parts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Completely Optional:[/b] If you don’t like skins, you’ll never encounter them. In multiplayer, you [b]won’t see other players’ skins[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Community Input:[/b] Alongside realistic camos, we’ve included 4 experimental skins. Let us know if they’re “too much” or still acceptable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/c6a84aa4a0b2bb8e5f80f6cff7166528308abccc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/e430f674c560e3f4866bcbaf8d7cf4e1e0fa2f58.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📸 Share Your Moments![/h3][p]Don’t forget to try the [b]Photo Mode[/b] and share your best in-game shots! We’d love to see your favorite moments on social media or in the Steam Community hub.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/f656fdde83dc8d360f2f525892648de0790750e6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
Please continue to share your experiences — your feedback is critical as we refine the game.

📥 [b]Download the demo now from the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/"]Steam Store page[/url].[/b]

notes.title: Update v0.1.3 – Operation Game Warden Now Available!
notes.content:
[p][b]Beyond Enemy Lines – Vietnam[/b] has just been updated to [b]v0.1.3[/b], and with it comes a brand-new mission: [b]Operation Game Warden[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]A New Type of Mission[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/2ce65aaf97fb4d3dae70d1a81fa0e24fe209423e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Operation Game Warden is inspired by real-world river patrol operations in Vietnam’s [b]Mekong Delta[/b], where U.S. forces worked to cut off Viet Cong supply routes along inland waterways.[/p][p]This is not a campaign mission — it’s part of a separate set of [b]standalone operations[/b], designed as [b]large, open-ended battlefields[/b]. You'll face scattered objectives and are free to approach them in any order or style, with full tactical freedom.[/p][p]These missions offer a [b]different gameplay structure[/b] compared to the more scripted and structured [i]Gridlock[/i] campaign mission. We want to know what you think of this sandbox-style mission format![/p][hr][/hr][h3]We Need Your Feedback![/h3][p]We're actively monitoring all feedback during the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] and will continue to improve the demo throughout the event.[/p][p]🛠 Bug reports
💡 Suggestions
📈 Balance feedback[/p][p]Your voice matters, and your input helps us shape the future of the game.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]A Work in Progress[/h3][p]Remember, this is an [b]early slice of the game[/b]. You’ll encounter:[/p][list][*][p]Bugs and performance issues[/p][/*][*][p]Placeholder assets and sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Unfinished features[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re working hard to polish and expand what’s here — but we wanted to get it in your hands early to get your thoughts.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📸 Share Your Moments![/h3][p]Don’t forget to try the [b]Photo Mode[/b] and share your best in-game shots! We’d love to see your favorite moments on social media or in the Steam Community hub.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/f656fdde83dc8d360f2f525892648de0790750e6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
Please continue to share your experiences — your feedback is critical as we refine the game.

📥 [b]Download the demo now from the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/"]Steam Store page[/url].[/b]

[b]Wishlist Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam on Steam now: [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.2
notes.content:
[b]AI Behavior Update[/b]
• Increased search time: 20 → 50 seconds
• AI now properly reacts to nearby deaths and projectile impacts
• Return-to-patrol delay raised from 20 → 30 seconds

AI can now choose how to respond to suspicious events - either investigate or seek cover.
⚠️ Some units are trained to hold position in critical situations and won’t retreat or search.

notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved Player Hit Feedback

[*] Added randomized start loadout

[b]Streaming Performance Improvements[/b]

We've made significant improvements to level streaming performance, reducing lag spikes in most areas. However, you may still encounter brief stutters near the jungle watchtower, where a large city section is streamed in at once. We're actively working on further optimizations for this area and expect additional improvements in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam Dev-Log #04: Mission Editor
notes.content:
Hello, Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam community!

We’re excited to share a first look at our in-game Mission Editor! Here’s what’s coming to empower your creativity and expand the game’s potential with custom missions, cross-platform play, and even creator DLC opportunities.

[previewyoutube=OXZqJZ-daWs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Key Features of the Mission Editor[/h2]
🔹 [b]Cross-Platform Creation[/b]:
Easily create and play missions on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation with support for gamepad or keyboard and mouse.

🔹 [b]Pre-Built Assets & Customization Options[/b]:
Jumpstart your mission with a library of pre-built assets and creation kits. Note: all assets are still in development and will evolve before release.

🔹 [b]Time & Weather Control[/b]:
Adjust time of day and weather conditions in real-time—or change them dynamically during missions using custom scripts.

🔹 [b]User-Friendly Scripting[/b]:
Place script actors within your mission, customize their properties, and set conditions seamlessly with an easy-to-navigate properties panel.

🔹 [b]Real-Time Testing & Saving[/b]:
Save, load, and upload your creations with ease, and test them instantly within the editor.

🔹 [b]Large, Open Missions or Intricate Interiors[/b]:
Design sprawling outdoor missions with predefined landscapes or create detailed indoor scenarios—or combine both!

🔹 [b]Build Full Campaigns[/b]:
Develop full campaigns with seamless level transitions to tell your own story within Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam.

🔹 [b]Co-op & PvP Ready[/b]:
Create missions for solo play, co-op, and even PvP battles with our flexible mission editor.

💡 [h2]Creator Program[/h2]
Submit Your Campaigns:
Want to go further? Submit your custom campaigns (with at least 3 missions) for our review. If selected, we’ll polish your missions using our in-house tools and release them as official Creator DLC. [b]You’ll receive 50% of the earnings![/b]

We’d love your feedback on this early version of the Mission Editor to make it the best it can be. Thank you for your support, and please feel free to leave a comment with your ideas and suggestions.

Stay tuned for more updates and, as always, happy mission-building!

Sincerely,
Polygon Art
